exposure: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection status (HBsAg-positive vs HBsAg-negative)
cohort: The study included 13,980 pregnant women, with 1,059 in the HBsAg-positive group and 12,921 in the HBsAg-negative group.
finding: Pregnant women who tested positive for HBsAg had significantly higher rates of gestational diabetes mellitus, intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy, and preterm birth before 34 weeks.
cross-section timing: Data collected from 1st January 2020 to 31st December 2022
